label: Second-lift protocol
title: Completion-independent information, coordinate-dependent cost
kind: Frozen protocol with prior analytic and exploratory controls
summary: The Rule32 product-alphabet comparison fixes both completions, the inherited family, K/O depth/radius budgets, causal bounds and independent checks. Whole-field invariance is an existing theorem control; the new census remains unrun.
takeaway: Measure local radius and representation cost without treating a coordinate change as a change of retained whole-field dynamics. Implementation and evaluation remain a registered planned experiment.
